name: Fireflies.ai
tagline: Fireflies.ai is an AI meeting intelligence platform that joins your calls as a silent participant, records and transcribes everything, and delivers searchable, summarised notes. Its AI surfaces key topics, questions, and sentiment, and integrates with Salesforce, HubSpot, Slack, and 50+ other tools to automatically log meeting outcomes. Remote and hybrid teams use it to ensure nothing falls through the cracks.
